subject: english
topic: Oral English: vowel sounds (choose the word with the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS)

kept.q: In normal educated speech, three of the following words have the same vowel sound while one is different. Identify the ODD ONE OUT.
kept.explanation: COAT, BOAT and GOAT all have the diphthong /əʊ/. GOT, however, has the short vowel sound /ɒ/, which is different from the others.
kept.pidgin: COAT, BOAT and GOAT dey share di same diphthong sound /əʊ/. But GOT get short vowel sound /ɒ/, wey make am different from di rest.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: SHEEP
q.explanation: SHEEP has the long vowel sound /i:/. MACHINE also has this same long /i:/ sound, while BREAD, BUILD and WEIGHT have different vowel sounds.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: BLOOD
q.explanation: BLOOD is pronounced with the short /ʌ/ sound, not the long /u:/ sound its spelling suggests. GLOVE shares this same /ʌ/ sound, while FOOD, MOOD and ROOD all have the long /u:/ sound.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: TOWN
q.explanation: TOWN has the diphthong /aʊ/. SOUND shares this same diphthong sound, while KNOWN and GROWN have the /əʊ/ sound and GROUP has /u:/.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: EARN
q.explanation: EARN is pronounced with the central vowel sound /ɜː/, as in 'bird'. HEARD shares this same /ɜː/ sound, while FEAR, BEARD and NEAR all have the diphthong /ɪə/.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: COUGH
q.explanation: COUGH is pronounced with the sound /ɒf/, giving it the vowel /ɒ/. THOUGHT also carries this same /ɔ:/-related open back vowel quality, while THOUGH and DOUGH have /əʊ/ and ENOUGH has /ʌ/, making them different.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: WOMAN
q.explanation: The first syllable of WOMAN is pronounced with the short vowel /ʊ/. BOOK also has this same /ʊ/ sound, while WOMEN has /ɪ/, and MOVE and SOON have the long /u:/ sound.

q.q: Choose the word that has the same vowel sound as the letters in CAPITALS: AWAY
q.explanation: The first syllable of AWAY is unstressed and pronounced with the weak vowel sound /ə/, called the schwa. ARENA also begins with this same unstressed schwa sound, unlike APPLE, ANKLE and ANNEX, which begin with stressed vowel sounds.
